content.text:
{"dialogue": "Maya: ugh finally off, my brain is fried
Me: same, just closed my laptop and went straight to couch
Maya: blanket mode?
Me: obviously, still in work clothes tho lol
Maya: same, didn't even change yet
Maya: did your maybe-mug survive last night?
Me: kinda! glaze is weird but it holds water now
Maya: functional art wins again
Me: tuesday guy said it has character
Maya: lol that's code for lopsided
Me: 100%, how was your oat latte this morning?
Maya: actually good again, stomach has been way better
Me: that's good, still doing the full dairy-free thing?
Maya: yeah trying to be strict for a few weeks, no milk cheese butter
Maya: which is why i was looking at menus again
Me: oh no, Rosa's menu fail again?
Maya: kinda, they really only have that veggie no-cheese thing
Maya: then i saw Mario's on Pine Street has actual vegan cheese and dairy-free knots?
Me: oh interesting, that would be way better for you
Maya: right? i don't want you stuck eating sad no-cheese pizza with me
Me: lol i said i'd do solidarity but vegan cheese sounds better tbh
Maya: wanna just switch our thing there? same vibe but i can actually eat
Me: yeah let's do Mario's, easier for your test
Maya: yay thank you, dairy-free solidarity era
Me: oh btw annoying work thing
Me: my meeting on next friday, the 23rd got extended and now it runs till 12:15
Me: can we push from noon to like 12:30 instead?
Maya: yeah that works, 12:30 at Mario's on Pine Street is perfect for me
Me: thank youuu, i can slip out right after and be there quick
Maya: no rush at all, i'll walk over and grab us a table
Maya: i'll do a chair safety test in your honor lol
Me: please, can't break tradition
Maya: patio if it's not freezing? or inside is fine
Me: either's good, just happy we don't have to do the smell-the-knots thing anymore", "writer_note": "Kept the afternoon couch-check-in voice and used the dairy-free test as a natural reason to switch venues to Mario's, then slotted the time-shift request with the 12:15 meeting reason so Maya's acceptance locks time and place."}
